description: Territoires à Risque d’Inondation important (TRI BASSE-TERRE)- Enjeux activités économiques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Homogeneous zones describing a type of economic activity located on an IRR. Data sets produced by the GIS Flooding Directive at a significant risk of flooding (TRI) of Guadeloupe and mapping for reporting purposes for the European Flood Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Territories at significant flood risk (TRI BASSE-TERRE)- Issues economic activities" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Directive inondation, Zones à risques naturelles, TRI. The listing shows 2020-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
